import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.impute import KNNImputer

data = pd.read_csv('dataset.csv')
imputer = KNNImputer(n_neighbors=5)
numeric_cols = data.select_dtypes(include='number').columns.tolist()
data_imputed = pd.DataFrame(imputer.fit_transform(data[numeric_cols]), columns=numeric_cols)
mean_bp = float(data_imputed['blood_pressure'].mean())
print({'key': 'mean_blood_pressure_after_imputation', 'value': round(mean_bp, 6)})
